snippet.title: You Can Sort It! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A cozy soda-sorting sim set in a little shop. All 5760 cans have spilled across the floor - pick them up, read the labels, and shelve every one by flavor. No timers, no pressure. Sort alone, or with up to three friends.

Wishlist on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146090/You_Can_Sort_It/
